notes.title: May 28th update
notes.notes:
Fixed several bugs:
1. Fixed the problem that trees and bushes cannot be destroyed
2. Fixed the problem that boxes, looms, etc. cannot be placed on the foundation
3. Fixed the problem that doors and locks will be generated repeatedly
4. Increase the daytime time, reduce the night time, and optimize the sleeping time
5. Optimize the temperature system

notes.title: May 14 Major Update
notes.notes:
1.Added Vehicle System – Includes boats and submarines. The boat system features comprehensive interactive content such as a boat workbench, oven, bed, refrigerator, generator, engine, and more.

2.Two Large New Islands – Accessible only by boat, these islands offer abundant resources and exploration content.

3.Fixed Several Known Bugs.

4.Significant Performance Optimizations – Improved overall game performance across various systems.

5.Added Numerous Craftable Blueprints and Items – These provide a range of practical functions during sea voyages and at the boat workbench.

6.Exploration Route Optimization – Improved the flow and guidance of exploration throughout the game.

notes.title: Major Update on December 29
notes.notes:
Changes:

Completely revamped the original map, adding three stunning new scenes: an underwater shipwreck, airplane wreckage, and a hunter's cabin.
Introduced dozens of survival challenges and implemented a survival skill tree system.
Added dozens of clothing, pants, and shoes for characters, scattered throughout the game world.
Included dozens of third-person interactive actions.
Added UI and visual effects to the vast majority of interactive processes.
Redesigned the event system and treasure system.
Fixed several known bugs, such as:
Creatures respawning after loading a saved game.
Inability to enter caves.
Poisoning and disease values increasing automatically in specific scenes.
